summary: Polish and stabilization pass: add missing CI coverage for Python/JS adapters, fix api-extractor baseline drift for core, fix core typecheck failure, and establish test infrastructure for web-viewer package.

tasks.title: Add new Python adapters to CI pytest matrix
tasks.goal: Extend the CI 'python' job in .github/workflows/ci.yml to install and run pytest for adapters/openai-agents, adapters/autogen, and adapters/crewai in addition to the existing python and langchain adapters, ensuring the three new SDK-specific adapters are tested on every CI run across Python 3.10/3.11/3.12.
acceptanceCriteria: CI python job installs all five adapters via pip install -e ...[dev]
pytest invocation covers all five adapter directories
All 95+ Python adapter tests pass in CI matrix
Local reproduction matches CI install + pytest commands
tasks.testCommand: python -m pip install -e adapters/python[dev] -e adapters/langchain[dev] -e adapters/openai-agents[dev] -e adapters/autogen[dev] -e adapters/crewai[dev] && python -m pytest adapters/python adapters/langchain adapters/openai-agents adapters/autogen adapters/crewai -q

tasks.title: Restore api-extractor baseline for @agentgit/core
tasks.goal: Run pnpm --filter @agentgit/core api:update to regenerate the canonical API report, commit the updated packages/core/etc/agentgit-core.api.md, and verify that pnpm api:check (both core and sdk) exits 0 so the CI 'API surface' job passes and future public-API regressions are detected.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter @agentgit/core api:check exits 0
pnpm --filter @agentgit/sdk api:check exits 0
Root pnpm api:check exits 0
CI 'API surface' job passes on clean checkout
Committed baseline matches dist/index.d.ts public surface
tasks.testCommand: pnpm --filter @agentgit/core build && pnpm --filter @agentgit/core api:update && pnpm --filter @agentgit/core api:check && pnpm --filter @agentgit/sdk api:check && pnpm api:check

tasks.title: Fix MockInstance type errors blocking core typecheck
tasks.goal: Update type annotations for vi.spyOn variables in packages/core/src/__tests__/benchmarks-shape.test.ts so that tsc --noEmit passes under the project's strict settings (exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noUncheckedIndexedAccess), restoring the typecheck gate for the core package.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm --filter @agentgit/core typecheck exits 0
Root pnpm typecheck exits 0
Core package tests including benchmarks-shape.test.ts continue to pass
Fix is isolated to test file type annotations; no behaviour change

tasks.title: Add JS SDK adapter smoke tests to CI
tasks.goal: Add a CI job (or extend an existing job) that builds @agentgit/core and then runs `node --test adapters/anthropic-sdk/smoke.test.mjs` and `node --test adapters/vercel-ai-sdk/smoke.test.mjs`, ensuring the two JavaScript SDK adapters have automated regression coverage in the same manner as the Python adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: CI job executes both node --test smoke commands after core build
All 5 smoke tests (3 anthropic + 2 vercel) pass in CI
Job can be reproduced locally with same node + pnpm commands
Job failure is attributable to the specific adapter that broke
tasks.testCommand: pnpm --filter @agentgit/core build && node --test adapters/anthropic-sdk/smoke.test.mjs && node --test adapters/vercel-ai-sdk/smoke.test.mjs

tasks.title: Establish test infrastructure for web-viewer package
tasks.goal: Add vitest + happy-dom + testing-library dependencies and a vitest.config.ts to packages/web-viewer, create a package.json test script, and add at least two test files (bundle unpack + in-memory index) so that the web viewer has automated coverage of its core loading and query logic.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web-viewer/package.json has a test script and required devDependencies
packages/web-viewer/vitest.config.ts exists with happy-dom environment
At least one test file exercises readBundle or InMemoryIndex and passes
pnpm --filter @agentgit/web-viewer test exits 0
CI unit job (or new web-viewer job) runs and passes the new tests
Typecheck for web-viewer continues to pass
